errors.quote: That page gives linear contractions $A$, $B_0$ ($B_0$ is not the packing base) with $P_sF_s=2^{2\alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA$, computed in time $O(tp^{3/2+\delta}\alpha)$ without executing $P_s$ or $P_t$.
errors.problem: This reads as if $A$ and $B_0$ were computed exactly, under the hypothesis $t>s$ alone. In Lemma no-sort-resampling the algorithms are approximations $\widetilde A,\widetilde B_0$, each with error less than $p^2$, and they need $\theta=t/s-1>p/\alpha^4$, $2\le\alpha<\sqrt p$, $t<2^p$, $p>100$. Because the per-axis $p^2$ is never stated, the later 'error below $dp^2$' has no basis on the page.
